_readme: Reference repo config (written by `foreman onboard`, edited by hand). models.default applies to every stage until overridden; stage keys: plan, implement, review. fallback entries are 'provider/model[:thinking]' strings tried in order on provider errors (timeouts are NOT retried on another model — a hung stream is a host problem). required_checks: names of GitHub checks that must pass ([] = no CI gate). scenario.ports are RESERVED across all repos; runtime/holdout are file names relative to this directory. skip_labels: issues with any of these labels are never claimed. origin_url: override the clone URL (private repos with a token, or test fixtures). env: 'host' runs stages as plain processes; 'compose' runs every stage as root inside the product's own docker-compose worker service (compose_file is resolved in the worktree; the compose file must publish the scenario ports on 127.0.0.1) or in the fallback `image` with pip/uv/npm cache volumes until the repo ships a compose file — installs inside are ordinary work; the host stays clean. pass_env forwards host env vars into the container when present.
